ops.text: 36 districts, matching https://www.maharashtra.gov.in/Site/1529/Districts. Ahilyanagar is the legal DISTRICT name: Revenue & Forests notification TLC-2024/C.R.146/M-10 of 8 Oct 2024, recited in the Maharashtra Gazette Extraordinary of 13 Mar 2025, renamed the district and taluka, and the Zilla Parishad was renamed on that basis. Ahmednagar is an alias only. Bare 'Mumbai'/'Bombay' are not aliases of either Mumbai district: they name both, and the search offers both.
